title: North Korea and China Open Their Biggest Border Bridge
description: The long-delayed opening of the New Yalu River Bridge comes as the two countries expand trade despite international sanctions imposed on North Korea.

title: Why Does Saudi Arabia Struggle to Stop Houthi Attacks?
description: The Saudi military has expensive equipment, but the missiles and drones used by the Yemeni militia are difficult to detect and stop.

title: At Least 20 Children Dead After School Roof Collapses in Pakistan
description: The collapse, in Peshawar, also killed a teacher and injured more than 40 people. The country’s prime minister urged rescuers to speed up the search for survivors.

title: Zelensky Says Ukraine Will Resume Russian Refinery Strikes, Defying Trump
description: President Volodymyr Zelensky made the announcement in an interview with The Financial Times. He had paused the strikes to comply with a demand from the United States.

title: Пентагон намерен запросить у Конгресса $50 млрд на массовое производство дронов
description: Министерство войны США собирается запросить $50 млрд на массовое производство и масштабное внедрение в вооруженные силы уже в этом году сотен тысяч беспилотных систем, заявил глава Пентагона Пит Хегсет, выступая на ежегодном собрании Ассоциации армии США (AUSA) в Вашингтоне.

title: Главные новости к утру 15 октября // NYP: поставка нефти из РФ на рынок США ожидается в ближайшие две недели
description: Поступление российского дизельного топлива на американский рынок в «довольно существенном» объеме ожидается в ближайшие две недели, выяснил The New York Post. Замоскворецкий суд Москвы отправил под домашний арест экономиста, бывшего ректора Всероссийской академии внешней торговли Сергея Синельникова-Мурылева.

title: UK prosecutor labels Russell Brand a ruthless sexual predator as his sex assault trial begins
description: LONDON: Russell Brand behaved as a “ruthless” sexual predator when he assaulted six women over a decade, a prosecutor said Wednesday, as she opened the rape and sexual assault case against the actor-comedian. Brand, 51, has pleaded not guilty to three counts of rape, three counts of sexual assault and one count of indecent assault. The charges involve six women and alleged offenses between 1999 and 2009. title: Saudi researchers launch landmark space mission to study aging and brain disorders
description: RIYADH: Saudi Arabia has launched the first biological samples from the Middle East to space as part of the BioGravity-1 mission aboard a SpaceX resupply flight to the International Space Station, the Saudi Press Agency (SPA) reported. title: Russia’s Lavrov, China’s Wang discuss cooperation, Ukraine, Iran at Asia security meeting
description: Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov and Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi discussed bilateral cooperation and crises in Ukraine and Iran during an Asia security meeting.

title: US military weighs use of ‘mother of all bombs’ in potential future strikes on Iran, CNN says
description: The US military is considering deploying the GBU-43/B Massive Ordnance Air Blast Bomb against Iranian sites if operations resume. CNN reports this could escalate the conflict significantly.

title: ‘No time to recover’: UNDP chief sounds alarm on growing poverty after Iran war shock
description: The UN’s development chief has warned that escalating energy prices, influenced by the Iran war, El Nino, and higher interest rates, may push millions into poverty. Vulnerable countries face repeated crises, exacerbating global economic instability.

title: EU leaders head for showdown over bloc budget
description: BRUSSELS, Belgium: EU leaders on Thursday head for their biggest clash yet over the bloc’s next long-term budget, as they race to lock in a deal before next year’s French presidential election. The 27-nation European Union wants an agreement by Christmas, worried that any future dealmaking will be derailed by potential euroskeptic wins in polls taking place across the bloc — most crucially in key power France. title: IMF warns of slowing Asian growth, spillover from rising yields
description: BANGKOK: The International Monetary Fund on Thursday projected Asia’s economic growth would moderate next year and warned of heightening risks from the Iran war-induced energy shock, a potential correction in the AI boom and spillovers from rising global bond yields. title: Alberta independence vote tests Canada’s unity amid US tensions
description: TORONTO: Alberta voters decide next week if they want the oil-rich province to begin the process of separating from Canada, a pivotal test for the country as it confronts a hostile United States. title: Ukraine live: Romania probes possible drone attack on tanker
description: Romania on Wednesday was probing a possible fresh drone attack on a tanker off its Black Sea coast. Suspected Russian drones have hit several ships off Romania and neighbouring Bulgaria since last week in the latest spillover from the Ukraine war in the Black Sea. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.

title: Thousands protest across Colombia against new right-wing president
description: Thousands of Colombians protested peacefully across the country on Wednesday against right-wing President Abelardo de la Espriella, in the opposition’s first major demonstrations since he took office in August. Former leftist President Gustavo Petro led a rally in Bogota, joined by trade unionists, Indigenous groups, students and feminist activists.

title: Retired US generals call on Pentagon to cancel 'barbaric' execution livestream
description: Livestreaming the execution of Nidal Hasan "will taint the honor of the military that employs it, and a nation that allows it," 72 former officers said in a letter.

title: Argentina’s Milei backs Trump for US midterms, calls vote crucial for West
description: The US Presidents ally says conservatives “cannot give an inch” in Latin America as he accepts an award in Washington.

title: Albanian Ministry of Justice on fire as education protesters riot
description: Hundreds of students joined anti-government protests in Tirana, demanding education reforms.
